Package aor.proj3t.resource

Class EvaluationResource

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.resource.EvaluationResource
@Path("/evaluations") @RequestScoped @Produces("application/json") @Consumes("application/json") public class EvaluationResource extends Object
REST endpoint for evaluation-related operations.

This class is responsible for handling requests related to evaluations, including creation, updates, bulk closure, and cycle management. It ensures that the incoming data is validated and routed to the appropriate service-layer methods based on user roles and authorization context.
